description: This file is a shell test script for a Git testing environment, specifically testing diff features with binary and text files, handle binary merges, and text conversions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of files, asserting equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a given message and content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
